title: Cleanup scan completion step
statement: Let $k$ be a nonnegative integer and let $w$ and $s$ be Boolean words. One cleanup-machine step from the scan configuration at count $|s|$ yields the configuration in state $(1,\mathrm{false})$ with all scratch tapes blank, the first tape storing the word obtained by appending one $1$ to $s$ if $|s|\le |w|$ and otherwise leaving $s$ unchanged, the input head at the saturated position for $|s|$, and all work heads at displacement $|s|-1$.
replaced:
One step of the cleanup machine from the end of its scan phase clears the
final extra scratch cell and appends a $1$ to the candidate exactly when the
candidate's length is at most the input length; the result is the cleaned
configuration holding one split-search step applied to the candidate.
